If you’re looking for the most up‑to‑date lineup:

* **MSG Events Calendar** – Visit the Madison Square Garden’s own calendar page ([msg.com/events](https://www.msg.com/))—they list all sporting events as well as concerts, shows, and other activities.  
* **Ticketmaster / TicketWeb** – These sites also show the full event roster for the arena.

Once you’ve got the date handy, just plug it into one of those resources and you’ll see whether the Knicks are hosting a game, who their opponent is, and when it starts. If you let me know the exact day, I’d be happy to help interpret the schedule once you pull it from one of those sources!
